verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video/audio platform, so a UDP-blocked transport fallback is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket, or the conditions under which it would engage. The global mesh network item covers latency, packet loss and jitter, not transport fallback.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, a stream survives a network that blocks UDP: the service documents fallback over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket and when it engages
